scope: GINA 2021 executive summary on treatment steps, ICS-formoterol, and the fact that symptom control does not exclude severe exacerbations.

keyRecommendations.text: ICS-formoterol reduces severe exacerbations by at least 60% in mild asthma compared with SABA alone.
Track 1 uses as-needed ICS-formoterol across steps, plus regular ICS at step 2 or ICS-LABA at steps 3–5.
keyRecommendations.population: Adults and adolescents in the summary

keyRecommendations.text: Step 5 adds LAMA and azithromycin, and biologic therapy for severe asthma. Poor symptom control is not required for a life-threatening exacerbation.

clinicalBottomLine: Do not use SABA alone in mild asthma when ICS-formoterol is the strategy that cuts severe exacerbations, and remember that a person with few symptoms can still have a life-threatening attack.
notableCaveats: Figures in the PDF are not all reproduced as text. MCQs use the prose statements.

source.title: Global Initiative for Asthma Strategy 2021: executive summary and rationale for key changes.
